Plugin Reference > db — Local Columnar Database Plugin

db — Local Columnar Database Plugin

Zig 0.17This plugin is built with Zig 0.17: the 0.17 branch builds with Zig 0.17 and passes the Zig unit tests; the old 0.14.1 branch is kept unchanged.
GuideThis plugin has a dedicated chapter, "db Database Plugin": all 14 CLI commands explained one by one, the full signatures of the eight SA API groups, a complete macro usage example, the vs SQLite selection comparison, and performance boundaries. This page keeps only a quick-reference summary.

sa_plugin_db is SA's native database plugin: it provides local, file-backed columnar storage, with an SA-facing db.sai/db.sal interface. The current development API intentionally makes breaking changes: the old direct-query ABI has been removed, and query code must use read handles (the *_handle family).

Basic facts

  • Capability segment: database; no plugin dependencies; interfaces db.sai + db.sal.
  • Permissions: only read/write/create/delete in the project directory; no network, no environment variables, no child processes.
  • Artifacts: zig-out/lib/libdb.so / zig-out/bin/db.dll.
  • Storage layout (one file set per table): <table>.sadb-schema, <table>.meta, <table>.col<index>.<segment>.dat, etc.

CLI commands

SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1 sa db init <schema.sadb-schema>   # 按模式初始化表
SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1 sa db ingest <table> rows.csv     # 从 CSV/JSONL 批量导入
SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1 sa db register <query.sa>         # 注册 qmod 查询，输出 Hash
SA_PLUGIN_DEV=1 sa db exec <hash> [--params file] # 执行已注册查询
sa db index-u64 <table> <column-index> [unique]   # 建 u64 索引
sa db inspect|status <table>                      # 查看
sa db snapshot / restore / recover / verify / compact <table>
sa db lock / unlock <table>

SA-side API groups

Capability domainRepresentative calls / macros
Table creation and writessa_db_init_schema, _ingest_columns, _insert_row, and the _upsert_row_*_key / _update_row_*_key for each integer/blob key kind; macros DB_INIT_SCHEMA, DB_INSERT_ROW
Transactionssa_db_tx_begin/_commit/_rollback/_insert_rows and the sa_db_coltx_* column transactions (single table, single writer)
IndexesThe per-type sa_db_create_*_index (u64/i32/f64/u64_pair/blob_eq/blob_prefix/blob_contains…) and the batch sa_db_create_indexes
Read-handle queriesAfter sa_db_open_read_table, use _sum_u64_handle, _range_u64_handle, _filter_rows_u64_range_handle, _intersect/union/except_rows_handle, _sort_rows_*_handle, _project_rows_handle, etc.
Dictionaries and blobssa_db_dict_intern/_lookup, sa_db_blob_put, sa_db_blob_value_len/copy
Logical typesParts encoding/decoding for decimal/date/timestamp (such as sa_db_decimal_from_parts), null bitmap helpers
Operationssa_db_snapshot/_restore/_recover/_verify/_compact/_lock/_unlock/_remove_table
// 最小用法（摘自 benchmark_test/db_blob_key_write_smoke.sa）
@import "db.sal"

    EXPAND DB_INIT_SCHEMA init_status, ROOT, ROOT_LEN, SCHEMA_PATH, SCHEMA_PATH_LEN, SCHEMA, SCHEMA_LEN, info
    EXPAND DB_BLOB_PUT put_a_status, code_a_id, ROOT, ROOT_LEN, TABLE, TABLE_LEN,
                       STORE, STORE_LEN, CODE_A, CODE_LEN, info
    store row+0, 1 as u64
    EXPAND DB_INSERT_ROW insert_a_status, ROOT, ROOT_LEN, TABLE, TABLE_LEN, row, ROW_BYTES, info
WarningPositioning boundary (stated explicitly in the README): this is not a replacement for SQLite-style ACID/WAL/multi-table isolation. Transactions are single-table, single-writer; the write path is serialized by an in-process mutex plus a per-table advisory lock, and commits go through a temporary file with atomic rename. Floating-point indexes reject NaN/±Inf; blob contains indexes require the needle to be at least 3 bytes. For the Chinese description, see README_cn.md in the repository.
